message: 復習の鬼
Exams were over, and the results had already been posted. With just over a month left until the Holy Night Festival, it was finally time for us as the Student Council to kick things into full gear.

name: Paqy
message: 「Talk about unoriginal. You planning to dig up some Christmas trivia at the library or something?」

name: Synn
message: 「There's that too, yeah, but my real target is old graduation anthologies.」

name: Synn
message: 「We have photos of the Holy Night Festival from its very first run up to last year filed away in the Student Council room, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, those were strictly taken from an officer's perspective... What I want to know is the impression it left on individual students.」

name: Synn
message: 「If we read through the anthologies, we're bound to find entries on the Holy Night Festival--and get a feel for what kind of people the graduates who wrote them were.」

name: Synn
message: 「There's no harm in looking into what kinds of things stuck in their memories from the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah, that sounds like a massive pain in the ass. Won't that take all damn day?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's way easier than studying for exams! Come on, let's go!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Sei--」
I started to call out to her, but managed to swallow Misa's name halfway. She was sitting at a reading desk, studying with a serious expression. I shouldn't disturb her.
Misa was staring intently at some printed sheets.
...No, wait. Those are test question papers. The results and rankings were announced, but the answer sheets haven't been returned yet.
She's probably self-grading them right away as a review, tackling the problems she couldn't solve.

name: Misa
message: 「This part... goes like this... Yeah, that's right...」
Could it be...
I feel a slight sense of crisis.
Both preparation and review are important, yet doing both equally is difficult. You inevitably tend to lean toward one or the other.
Still, neither preparation nor review is superior; it all comes down to how well they suit the person studying. You just need to prioritize whichever is easier for you.
I'm the preparation type. And Misa must be the review type.
Misa puts in this much effort... If she ever switched to being the preparation type, wouldn't our class ranks swap places in no time?

name: Misa
message: 「This part is... wrong, isn't it... Hmph, hmmm...」
I can't afford to slack off either.
Where were the reference bookshelves again? Let's go look.
On tiptoes, I quietly slip away from Misa's side--

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on right there. Ignoring someone and just leaving disqualifies you as Student Council President, wouldn't you say? I'd expect at least a greeting.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You noticed?」

name: Misa
message: 「Naturally. I hate you, after all, Sakura-kun. Your footsteps get converted into a special frequency when they reach my ears.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Really?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm not lying!」

name: Synn
message: 「I've also felt that way about you for a long time, Misa--」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Huh?!」

name: Synn
message: 「To my eyes, Misa, your hair looks like it's shining gold.」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaa! Well, that's only obvious!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph! If you have time to wrap me around your finger, you're going to answer this problem for me.」
Misa points at a math worksheet. Only the final question has all sorts of equations scribbled across it, showing signs of real struggle.
Oh, this one... It's a really twisted trick question...

name: Misa
message: 「I couldn't solve it. But you got it right, didn't you, Sakura-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How can you say that for sure?」

name: Misa
message: 「This question is worth 13 points. An awkward number just to make the total add up. And the difference between your score and mine was also 13 points.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, if you're okay with me, I can tell you the answer to that problem.」

name: Misa
message: 「No.」

name: Misa
message: 「I'll find the solution using my own strength. So I want you to give me hints only.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Now that's a tall order. It'd be easy if you could just tell her the right answer.」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm. A hint, a hint... Right here, Misa...」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee.」
Playing the amateur teacher, I falter as I try to guide Misa along.
Th-This is hard...! Convincing Misa during a Student Council meeting is way easier than this.

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, hmm...」

name: Misa
message: 「I managed to make it partway through. Look, check this part.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm?」
At this rate, I can't even tell who's supposed to be teaching whom. Feeling embarrassed, I start worrying about people around us watching.
However, nobody else is sitting at the reading table besides the two of us.
Books have been placed in front of all the chairs as a sign that someone is saving the seats... except there are way too many of them.
One or two books would make sense, yet there are stacks of twenty or thirty piled up.
H-Huh...? Aren't all of these graduation anthologies?
On top of that, they even have a complete collection of indie zines published privately by clubs and societies.
As far as I know, there's only one person who would collect nothing but books like these.

name: Synn
message: 「There are three hints, and the first one is--」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmm...? Oh, right...」
I'll stick with Misa all the way through. If I do, we're bound to get through the review efficiently and finish up fast.
After that, I'd love for the two of us to keep reading through the anthologies together.
